title: Construct the selected native and finite compiler instances jointly under three retained contracts
body:
## Selected κ = 0.00363005817 under three unchanged retained contracts

This package gives a **joint construction of the selected native and finite compiler instances**, retaining exactly `owned_erasure`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery` in their pinned selected meanings. It is an alternative implementation of the #7000/#7001 raw words with larger fixed finite carriers. The canonical selected record is unchanged: **no new κ and no unconditional multiplication theorem**.

[Proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/PROOF.md) · [Separate cross-review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Orchestrator review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a/research/selected-native-compiler-closure/ROOT-REVIEW.md)

### Why the joint construction is needed

#7828 supplies the single-grade compiler and #7840 supplies selected native realization under the other four contracts. Two conditional implications alone do not establish joint existence. This proof first establishes raw all-column denotations with formal positive queries; generates and freezes the finite instruction list without evaluating a query; chooses the binary cover prime after the complete matcher catalogue; then implements execution by **(completed ordinary stage, active width)**. Same-stage children decrease width, and movement uses a completed earlier stage. The elementary stage assumes no fast supplier.

Every discarded target has a distinct real zero-owned field and earns no productive credit. Every paid query remains charged, including zero-valued queries. Complete L/R adapters surround positive splits, spectators remain in the original root, and nonzero private clears retain the ownership contract.

### Actual new-template parameters

| Selected source | Product length v | H, where N = 2^H |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| BIT | 68,719,476,736 | 21,179,507,725,498,843,136 |
| Complex | 281,474,976,710,656 | 817,416,431,103,305,304,760,123,392 |

Both have productive width at most N^15 and conservative pre-cover logical-record count O_source(N^51). The complete paid moment includes zero targets and all split queries. The covered binary saving is .0038525298; the same new carrier and prime support the cold chain 0 → .0034 → .0038507 → .00385248. The complex uniform saving exceeds the selected κ by 6×10^-14.

Proof §§5.1 and 6.1 bind the new counts, complete right-route costs, productive-cover divisor, simultaneous reservations and effective cutoffs to the exact canonical parameterized grammar. The complex tariff retains f≤p, O(p) descriptor addresses, complete reservations and source record-fibre conditions. Unfinished raw depth is at most 2(H+v), preserving the common-grid prefix allowance. All constants are fixed before operand length varies; no practical crossover or uniformity over growing templates is claimed.

The separate review derives a sufficient productive-row cutoff e≥2^(4H+100). It concerns productive rows only and must be maximized with the primitive, ownership, descriptor and outer cutoffs.

### Validation and integrity

From the repository root with standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-native-compiler-closure
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-native-compiler-closure --check-modes
```

The registered runner passed normal and optimized author checks, then the separate boundary checker. Orchestrator execution also passed. The boundary checker imports no contributor scientific engine and authenticates sixteen exact references. Evidence includes:

- 493 exact modal comparisons from a separate rational-series engine, nine algebraic calibrations, six funding mutations and seven changed-source controls.
- Eighteen full-field syntax cases with 1,209 native calls and 17,982 paid leaves, including 14,991 zero queries. The 918 nonzero retirements are counted uses of the retained ownership premise.
- Five syntax controls rejecting owner aliasing, wrong inverse return, omitted zero-query charges, tensor-powered exterior scalars and inverse leaves.
- Independent new-carrier, common-grid, productive-row and cold-stage checks.

Remote head `715b07832f433414c8a3a66284668192846e618a` has exactly the tested local tree: 42 added files, no deletions. Offline source authentication uses Git blob and SHA256 pins. The committed-byte/mode gate passed at that exact remote head. Strict source-history preflight was not claimed from the shallow checkout.

Finite executions corroborate the written inductions; they do not establish the universal theorem by sampling. The full selected native catalogue and complete rounded multiplier were not freshly replayed. Hosted CI success is not claimed: unchanged base onboarding failed on #8091 before package selection because docs/ci.md still names #6030 while the selected record requires #7000.

### Overlap, remaining work and credit

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; task `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined to the native/compiler circularity. Principal sources: Ali Romman's #7828 at `03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5` and #7840 at `adf2e0aa6777977a280ce50f8938f4a0f4f19b76`, building on #7837. #7844 has priority for rational C-word grammar and phase-preserving complex compiler admission; it does not supply this joint binary/complex implication. #7846 concerns another mixed-rank construction and its stronger assumption claims are not imported. Earlier reviewed packages stay unchanged.

Remaining work: a complete allocator/eraser for the new target banks and suspended parents; a physically priced full matcher/descriptor route; and the retained analytic, fine-prime and exact-recovery implication. The frozen author proof preserves its pre-review status line for hash identity; the later separate review accepts that exact version. External independent mathematical assessment remains open.

Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate task-agent author/reviewer roles. This is model-assisted scoped review, not human peer review or kernel acceptance. Credit Ali Romman, the CubeJerry/DreamingOfClouds selected-source lineage, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cinna Davis and all retained notices. Apache-2.0 attribution is preserved.
